info.about: Killer7 is a 2005 action-adventure game developed by Grasshopper Manufacture and Capcom and published by Capcom for the GameCube and PlayStation 2.
info.trivia: Suda51's cel-shaded assassin game, one of the Capcom Five, ported to PS2 with censorship changes.
info.why: Moderate supply; a PC port in 2018 covers players, so prices are mid-range.
